The timing gap between alarm acknowledgment and restoration suggests a system-level event rather than an immediate procedural fix."
    },
    {

      "toKey": "n-m7dkz5",
      "type": "caused",

      "sourceIds": [

      "claimIds": [],

      "competingExplanation": "A transient valve closure or sensor glitch could mimic a localized failure without physical damage.","evidenceGap":"No record identifies which specific component failed or why it self-corrected."
    },
    {

  "decision": {
    "summary": "The focal event (instrument-air interruption) was caused by a localized failure downstream of the North gallery, as indicated by stable upstream pressure. Contributing factors include incomplete documentation, unclear communication medium, and environmental conditions that may have affected response time. The exact origin remains unknown due to limited data.",

      "Whether informal communication was sufficient",
      "Environmental conditions during the event"
    ],"alternatives":[
      "Upstream source failure ruled out by stable P-U pressure.",
      "System-wide failure unlikely given localized drop."],

  },"evidenceRequests": [
    "Request IA-P02_point_register.md to check for any additional valve state records or timestamps that might clarify the failure origin.","Request IA-S01_shift_and_notification_log.md to verify if there were any informal communications recorded between Utilities and RHOB."
